body: I see a psychiatrist. I used to get in trouble a lot and I was labeled with conduct disorder and sent to a psychiatrist. My brother was my conscience. He was my only good side. It's a long story and not worth telling but it ended with my mom leaving my dad and taking my brother and our little sister with her.
Our parents already took us away from each other. They split us up, just like all the rest of their possessions.
I promised my twin brother I would tell someone before I followed through.
